date_note: Date of the Men Today article; complaints began on the evening of 15 November.
exec: Outages of search, mobile and home internet in Russia; businesses reliant on Russian services may see disruption.
plain: Users in many Russian regions reported Yandex, Dzen and home and mobile internet not working. No cause has been given.
summary: Men Today reported on 16 November that users across Russia, in what it calls several dozen regions, had problems with Yandex search, Dzen, and home and mobile internet, with most complaints about Beeline and Rostelecom. Downdetector showed more than 3 thousand complaints in Moscow over a day. Provider SkyNet in St Petersburg had home internet down overnight; the article gives no cause for any of the outages.
title: Reports of wide internet and Yandex outages across Russia, no cause stated

validation.note: Only Men Today read; no operator or official statement found.

review.note: Compared date, several dozen regions, Beeline/Rostelecom complaints, Downdetector Moscow over 3,000 in a day, SkyNet overnight outage and no stated cause against Men Today
